name: g67_struggle_sub_balloon
purpose: Step G67, Struggle into a Substitute with an Air Balloon holder: Raichu holds the Balloon behind its Substitute, Gliscor uses Struggle into it (step 50 of campaign seed 6700000, battle 3, the case fz_6700000_3). The sub takes the hit ([damage]), Struggle's recoil is applied next ([from] recoil), and only then the Balloon pops (-enditem), since the move body applies the recoil after the hit loop (data/moves.ts AfterSubDamage after the recoil; sim/battle-actions.ts:1379-1395).
